name: Home Layout Grid & Responsive Layout Audit

mutations.name: the home hero card stops rendering
mutations.why: The gate walks the home screen in several modes and captures each one. If the screen it is looking for is gone it has to say so rather than save an empty picture. Repointed 2026-09-30: it renamed the export, which does not build — the runner used to swallow that and run the gate on the old bundle, so this mutation was never actually seen (external audit V12-2). It now builds and renders nothing.

mutations.name: the daily card slides up over the duel cards
mutations.why: A layout that renders and is wrong: the card is there, the picture is saved, and it covers the row above. The old gate passed this.

mutations.name: the ghost chip stops showing the recorded time
mutations.why: The time is what tells the player there is a record to race; --:-- over a real record reads as no record.

mutations.name: the chips read the classic record on the killer switch
mutations.why: Killer ghosts have their own slot since 2026-10-14 (KP-3). Read without the kind, the killer chip shows the classic 01:06 — a time no killer can race — instead of the killer's own 03:42.
mutations.find: const ghost = getGhostForModeLevel(isTimeLimit ? 'timeAttack' : selectedMode, selectedLevel, variant);

mutations.name: killer has no Survival on the home card
mutations.why: Added 2026-10-14 with killer Survival (KP-2). The killer's modes lose Survival: on the killer card the tab does nothing and the Classic start stays — the player cannot reach a killer Survival from Home.
mutations.expectFailure: the Survival tab on the killer switch did not switch to Survival

mutations.name: the home screen keeps only 14px under its last card
mutations.why: D50 (2026-11-06), the rule as it shipped through 32: the fixed bottom nav takes no room in the page, so on a small phone or a larger font the daily card sat under it and could not be scrolled into view — a friend's "the home screen does not scroll".
mutations.expectFailure: the bottom nav covers the last card

mutations.name: the nav is never measured
mutations.why: D50. Without the ref the screen falls back to a guessed 72px — enough at these font scales, so the overlap check alone would pass; the room must be the nav's own height, which grows with the font and the safe area.

mutations.name: the nav is measured once and never again
mutations.why: D50. Measured only on mount, the room stays at the nav's first height when the font grows afterwards (the 1.3x cases here change the font after the screen is up).

note: Until 2026-09-30 this gate saved screenshots and asserted nothing (external audit V05). It now measures the home screen in five states; the mutations below break the layout while it still renders.
